title: _import_demo (internal — record.py imports Scans\First silently so the teach video has an example)
description: Sets the import folder over DevTools (no native picker) and processes it; waits for the batch to finish.

steps.js: (async () => { const folder = "{{SCANS_FIRST_JS}}"; selectedFolder = folder; const parts = folder.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/'); folderDisplay.textContent = parts.length > 3 ? '…/' + parts.slice(-2).join('/') : folder; folderDisplay.title = folder; folderDisplay.classList.add('set'); folderBox.classList.remove('cue'); btnRun.disabled = false; const d = document.getElementById('dash-folder'); if (d) { d.textContent = folder; d.classList.add('set'); } await showFolderPreview(folder); return folder; })()
